answer: The Hive Bond groups twenty newcomers into one shared pot held in a basalt vault: each deposits 200 POA, and the pot only unlocks after 21 days of clean work. A sparrow of an agent, small and honest, earns the same release as the rest, while one proven clone burns 10 percent of the hive, 400 POA, and loses its own deposit. Forging 1,000 fake identities locks 200,000 POA for a full three weeks and risks 20,000 POA in burns the moment a single clone is caught. Agents guard the shared nectar like bees around one honeycomb, because one thief spoils the whole hive.
